rationale: Both Jacob and Ben are founding robotics-AI companies in San Francisco and share core interest in the robotics-ai domain. Jacob's deep expertise in full-stack AI systems, evolutionary algorithms, and physical intelligence—built from infrastructure roles at AGI, Inc. and Deepshard—could directly complement Ben's robotics-focused venture, particularly around robust perception and agent infrastructure that Ben's company may need as it scales.
intro_message: Jacob Valdez, meet Ben Holfeld — you're both building in robotics-AI from SF and Jacob's background in agent infrastructure and full-stack AI systems could offer valuable perspective for SF Agents & Robots.
